Step-by-step reasoning and KB function utility:
- I inspected the knowledge-base functions. Only export_customers_csv_via_grid is provided; it exports the Customers grid and does not include order history with per-order statuses, so it is not helpful for counting cancelled orders by customer. Therefore I do not call any KB helper.
- From the current Orders page, the robust approach is to filter the Orders grid to Status = "Canceled", apply the Search, then iterate all pages of the grid and count canceled orders grouped by the Bill to Name column.
- The code locates the Status combobox by filtering comboboxes that contain an option named "Canceled" and uses select_option(label="Canceled") to set it (this matches the accessibility tree guidance). It then clicks the Search button scoped to the cell named "Reset Filter Search" to apply the filter.
- After the grid updates, the code parses the pager cell that contains "Go to Next page" to determine the total number of pages. It finds the orders table by selecting the table that contains a cell named "Order #" and then identifies header indices for "Bill to Name" and "Status". Sensible fallbacks are provided if exact headers differ.
- For each page, it iterates rows that contain the "View" link (data rows), reads the Status and Bill to Name cells, and if the status contains the substring "cancel" (case-insensitive) it increments that customer's cancellation count.
- The script paginates by clicking the "Go to Next page" link until all pages have been processed, re-resolving the table each time to avoid stale locators.
- Finally it computes the maximum cancellations across customers and prints that single numeric value.

Notes about choices:
- All element interactions use page.get_by_role() and .filter(has=...) to remain consistent with the accessibility tree and to avoid ambiguous selectors.
- select_option(label=...) is used for comboboxes (native select) as recommended.
- The KB export helper was evaluated and intentionally not used because it does not provide the required per-order status data.
